scope: Isolated guest Edge, existing local MP3 decode/playback. Full run does not seek or accelerate music; ordinary rhythm notes use the existing QA input hook, listening answers use actual pointer buttons. Viewport emulation is not physical-device rotation, latency, heat, or audible listening proof.
